derived_metrics.whole_file_failures: all items[*].files[*] where passes is false
derived_metrics.scope_coverage: resolved item paths / declared item paths
derived_metrics.ready_failures: items where admission_state == ready and (admission_pass is not true or d2a_pass is not true or d2b_pass is not true or len(admission_gaps) > 0)
derived_metrics.historical_evidence: items where admission_state == historical-pre-v2, reported without hard pass or fail
derived_metrics.pending_producers: items where admission_state == pending-producer, reported as deferred
derived_metrics.scope_coverage_by_admission_state: resolved and declared item paths grouped separately by ready, historical-pre-v2, and pending-producer

per_file_overhead.applied: once per file occurrence on each item path

included: all five resolved executor slots for every item
all whole-file or selected bundle inputs
generated carriers resolved by the path or bundle
all unreadable, missing, stale, ambiguous, and oversized evidence as failures
excluded: owner-only carriers absent from every executor path
designer-only carriers absent from every executor path
history and audit carriers absent from every selected bundle
scope_manifest.exclusion_rule: exclude only when the carrier resolves to no executor path and no selected bundle entry

thresholds.unit: estimated upper-bound input tokens from token-estimate-calibration v2.0.0 for codex/gpt-5.6-terra using codex-exec-jsonl-v1 and differential-input-total-v2

arms.claim: Conversion preserves or improves the same migrated executable plan under the frozen protocol.
The current task:plan-design new path can create a real executable plan satisfying the frozen protocol.

aggregate_metric.formula: sum of complete mandatory item-path weights including generated carriers and per-file overhead

anti_displacement.escape_question: Could this have passed exclusively by splitting, moving, caching, deferring, or excluding work?
anti_displacement.escape_test: invariant traversal plus aggregate comparison plus complete scope coverage plus unresolved-input and whole-file guards

conditions: any ready item fails admission, D2(a), D2(b), or has an admission gap
a ready input is missing, unreadable, stale, ambiguous, or undeclared
the migrated aggregate does not demonstrate a real reduction
the escape answer is positive or unresolved
arm values or claims are merged
the frozen contract changes after the first run
the session canary differs from any frozen expectation
failure_definition.deferred_when: no ready failure exists and at least one pending-producer exists
failure_definition.historical_pre_v2_policy: evidence-only; never hard pass or fail

instance_author.responsibility: create or migrate the plan and retain intervention provenance

measurement_owner.responsibility: maintain plan-weight, calibration, read-limit, and deterministic raw evidence

acceptance_reviewer.responsibility: check raw evidence, protocol identity, scope escape, and separate arm claims

confounds: authors know the metric and thresholds
the same repository team creates both instances
each arm is one internal case and remains n=1
Codex is the certified provider row for this acceptance
the migrated plan can contain disclosed post-conversion evolution
dogfooding demonstrates internal feasibility, not external validity or comparative superiority

session_canary.output: JSONL provider events plus journal and plan-session evidence

branches.extra_gate: reviewer actor and route differ from root
reviewer actor and route differ from root
boundary_reason is exactly one hard_boundary_reasons value

session_canary.root_carrier_rereads_definition: full root-path rereads only; bounded reviewer capsules excluded

change_control.after_first_run: reopen 2026.08.07-PLAN-ECONOMY P6.7, add a linked owner D-record, assign a new version, and preserve every prior result with report and hashes
